$$ \text{Length} = \frac{\text{Perimeter}}{4} = \frac{32}{4} = 8 \text{ metres} $$

The area of the square is:

$$ \text{Area} = \text{Length} \times \text{Length} = 8 \times 8 = 64 \text{ square metres} $$

$$
2w + 2(2w) = 36

$$

$$

$$
6w = 36
$$

$$
w = 6
$$

So the width is 6 centimeters and the length is $2 \times 6 = 12$ centimeters.

Therefore, the length is 12 centimeters.
